description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper (QRScannerView) around a UIViewController for QR code scanning, integrating with DataScannerViewController and handling recognition of QR codes to trigger deep link actions or error reporting.

classes.name: QRScannerView.Coordinator
classes.description: Coordinator class managing the QRScannerView delegate callbacks, error handling, and recognizing scanned QR code data to trigger appropriate actions.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController instance for scanning QR codes, handling support and availability checks.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: Placeholder for updating the UIViewController; currently does nothing.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops scanning and triggers onDismiss callback when the view is dismantled.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates the Coordinator instance to handle delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Handles error reporting, ensuring it is called only once, and invokes the parent's onError callback.

methods.name: dataScanner:didAdd:allItems:
methods.description: Processes detected items, extracting QR code payloads, and triggers callbacks for recognized deep links.

methods.name: dataScanner:didRemove:allItems:
methods.description: Placeholder for handling removal of recognized items; currently does nothing.

methods.name: dataScanner:becameUnavailableWithError:
methods.description: Handles scanner unavailability errors by reporting via callback.
